title: A Black woman who loves her Husband is favorable to the Lord‼️
cleanTitle: A Black woman who loves her Husband is favorable to the Lord‼️
segments: Like when I have good news, I'm calling
my husband. If I've had a hard day, I'm
calling my husband. When I need advice
or a second opinion, I'm calling my
husband. When I need someone to tell me
the hard truth even when I don't want to
hear it, I call my husband. I mean, he
is the one I want to talk to when I'm
upset. If something super funny happens,
he's the first person I want to call.
And even when I don't feel like talking,
I just want him to sit beside me.
And it's not because I can't handle life
on my own, it's because he's my person
